title.purpose: The widget title in the chat header.

body.purpose: Answers, welcome text, visitor messages and the composer field.

meta.purpose: AI notice, stopped line, reference line.

credit.purpose: The one 'Powered by Purple Fabric' line.

answer-heading.purpose: An answer's h2 (Markdown h1, shifted down one level).

answer-subheading.purpose: h3: a step by weight alone, below the h2.

answer-minor-heading.purpose: h4 to h6, in Muted Umber.

code-label.purpose: The language label in a code panel's caption, Muted Umber, one line.

table-header.purpose: Header cells on Soft Sand, kept on one line.

shadows.name: launcher-hover
shadows.purpose: Launcher on pointer hover, paired with a 2px lift.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The floating panel. None when inline.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: The composer at rest; the sand edge becomes 0 0 0 2px #2b241f while focused.

shadows.name: jump-pill
shadows.purpose: The 'Go to the latest message' pill over the conversation.

shadows.name: sand-edge
shadows.purpose: Cards and the logo tile: keeps white distinct from the ground.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Two-tone focus ring that holds on any host page and any brand colour.

shadows.name: focus-chat
shadows.purpose: Focus on anything inside the chat, on the known warm ground.

shadows.name: scroll-edge-cue
shadows.value: radial-gradient(farthest-side at 0 50%, rgba(43,36,31,.22), transparent) left / 12px 100% no-repeat scroll, mirrored right; covered by linear-gradient(to right, <frame fill> 40%, transparent) left / 28px 100% no-repeat local, mirrored right
shadows.purpose: Code panels and table scroll areas: a soft ink shade at an inline edge only while more content lies that way.

shadows.name: focus-inset
shadows.purpose: Focus on a code body or table scroll area, drawn inside the clipped frame.

motion.name: spring-release
motion.purpose: Launcher settling back after a press, with a slight overshoot. Release only, never entry.

motion.name: panel-rise
motion.purpose: Panel open and close. Reduced motion keeps only the opacity fade.

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: Loading mark, only while the panel is open and the chat has not loaded.

motion.name: press-in-pill
motion.purpose: Suggested-question pill press, released on spring-release. Send uses press-in (scale .92).

motion.name: dots-breathe
motion.value: opacity .25 to 1 at 40%, 1.2s ease-in-out infinite, staggered .15s
motion.purpose: Three working dots on an empty answer card. Reduced motion holds them at .6 opacity.

motion.name: conversation-fade
motion.value: mask-image: linear-gradient(transparent, var(--ink) 14px, var(--ink) calc(100% - 14px), transparent)
motion.purpose: The conversation fades out over its top and bottom 14px, under the header and into the composer.

components.name: Launcher
components.description: The 56px round launcher in the customer's colour, glyph ink chosen by contrast. Sample brand shown.
components.html: <button class="ds-launcher" type="button" aria-label="Chat" style="--brand:#5B2A86;--ink:#ffffff"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 11.5a7.5 7.5 0 0 1-11.1 6.6L4 19.5l1.4-4.6A7.5 7.5 0 1 1 20 11.5z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-launcher{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand,#2b241f);color:var(--ink,#fff);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(43,36,31,.55),0 2px 6px -2px rgba(43,36,31,.3);transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-launcher svg{width:26px;height:26px}@media (hover:hover){.ds-launcher:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(43,36,31,.6),0 3px 8px -2px rgba(43,36,31,.32)}}.ds-launcher:active{transform:scale(.92);transition:transform .08s ease-out}.ds-launcher:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #2b241f}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-launcher,.ds-launcher:hover,.ds-launcher:active{transform:none;transition:none}}

components.name: Launcher (unbranded fallback)
components.description: The launcher when a configuration has no valid brand colour: Warm Ink with a white glyph.
components.html: <button class="ds-launcher-ink" type="button" aria-label="Chat"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>

components.name: Panel with loading mark
components.description: The warm 24px panel frame that holds the chat, shown before the chat page loads.
components.css: .ds-panel{position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;width:min(400px,100%);height:360px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:#fbf3ea;border:1px solid #e7dacb;box-shadow:0 24px 60px -24px rgba(43,36,31,.45),0 8px 20px -12px rgba(43,36,31,.25);animation:ds-rise .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:28px;height:28px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #e7dacb;border-top-color:#6f625a;animation:ds-spin .9s linear infinite}@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(1turn)}}@keyframes ds-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-panel{animation-name:ds-fade}.ds-panel::before{animation:none}@keyframes ds-fade{from{opacity:0}}}

components.name: Code panel
components.description: Code on the cream ground in a 12px sand-edged frame: language label, quiet copy, sideways scroll with the edge cue. No highlighting.
components.css: .ds-code{font-family:'Nunito Variable',Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;background:#fbf3ea;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #e7dacb;color:#2b241f;max-width:360px}.ds-code figcaption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;padding:4px 6px 4px 14px;border-block-end:1px solid #e7dacb;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:#6f625a}.ds-code figcaption>span{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-code pre{--edge:#fbf3ea;margin:0;padding:12px 14px;overflow-x:auto;font:13.5px/1.6 ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;tab-size:2;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--edge) 40%,transparent) left/28px 100% no-repeat local,linear-gradient(to left,var(--edge) 40%,transparent) right/28px 100% no-repeat local,radial-gradient(farthest-side at 0 50%,rgba(43,36,31,.22),transparent) left/12px 100% no-repeat scroll,radial-gradient(farthest-side at 100% 50%,rgba(43,36,31,.22),transparent) right/12px 100% no-repeat scroll,var(--edge);scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(111,98,90,.6) transparent}.ds-code pre:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2b241f;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 10px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#6f625a;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-quiet svg{width:18px;height:18px}.ds-quiet:hover{background:rgba(43,36,31,.06);color:#2b241f}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2b241f;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Table
components.description: Data on paper in a 12px sand-edged frame: sticky sand header, sand hairlines and cell rules, no stripes, tabular figures; tools row with copy and show-all.

narrative.overview:
The widget is a friendly consumer app sitting on someone else's page. It arrives as one small round button in the customer's colour and opens into a soft, warm-grounded panel that looks like an app the visitor already knows how to use. It does not dress up the host page or compete with it: the host's design comes first, the customer's colour comes second, and the world's own materials (a warm cream ground, a soft sand border, a deep warm ink) stay quiet underneath.

Inside, the chat is a calm warm page: answers on white cards, the visitor's own words in quiet sand bubbles, and the customer's colour only on suggested questions and the send button. Type is a rounded humanist sans, self-hosted, set in plain short sentences. Rich answers (headings, lists, code and tables) are made from the same materials: code sits on the cream ground, tables on paper, both framed by a sand edge, and anything too wide scrolls inside its own frame rather than stretching the conversation.

Depth is long, soft and low-contrast, tinted with the world's ink rather than grey. Motion is small and physical: a press that settles back with a slight overshoot, a panel that rises a short way and fades in without bouncing, three dots that breathe while an answer is on its way. Under reduced motion every movement goes; only the fade stays, and the dots hold still.

The world refuses the category default for chat widgets: no coloured header bar, no avatar, no brand-coloured message bubbles. The customer's colour appears only on things that can be pressed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm tinted ground, soft border and warm ink; never pure grey.
The customer's brand colour fills only actionable elements: the launcher, suggested questions, send and stop.
Generous, friendly corners: 24px panel and composer, 18px cards and bubbles, fully round launcher, pills and send.
Long, soft, ink-tinted shadows; surfaces inside the chat are separated by a 1px sand edge instead.
A press spring on release, a short rise-and-fade on open, no entry bounce.
Full screen on small windows; a floating panel anchored to the launcher's corner elsewhere.
Code and tables in their own 12px frames that scroll sideways, with a soft ink cue at an edge only while more lies that way.

rules.name: The Pressable Colour Rule
rules.body: The customer's brand colour appears only on things that can be pressed. Never on a header bar, a background, a border or a message surface.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral, including shadow tint, comes from the world's warm ink family. No cool or pure greys.

rules.name: The Pretty Wrap Rule
rules.body: Running text (the notice, cards and answer text) sets `text-wrap: pretty`, and anything user- or customer-supplied wraps anywhere rather than overflowing the panel. Code and tables are the exception: code never wraps and table cells wrap only between words (header cells not at all); both scroll sideways inside their own frame instead.

rules.name: The Own Frame Rule
rules.body: Content wider than the card (code, tables) scrolls sideways inside its own frame, never the card or the conversation. Each scroll region is reachable by keyboard and named for assistive technology. A table scrolls vertically only after the visitor has expanded it, and then within `min(70vh, 560px)`, so a short table never traps a thumb inside the conversation.

rules.name: The Long Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are long, soft, negatively spread and ink-tinted. No hard edges, no offsets without blur, no neutral black.

dos: Do keep the brand colour on pressable things only (launcher, suggested questions, send/stop), and pick the text and glyph colour on it (white or black) by contrast at runtime.
Do tint every shadow with Warm Ink (`rgba(43,36,31,…)`) and keep it long and soft.
Do use the two-tone focus ring (3px white outline, 7px Warm Ink band) on anything the widget draws over the host page, and the 3px Warm Ink outline 2px off inside the chat.
Do put answers on Paper White cards with a 1px Soft Sand edge, and the visitor's words on Soft Sand bubbles, both at 18px.
Do keep tap targets for pressable things at least 44px (36px for secondary and quiet actions inside a card).
Do open with a 12px rise and a 200ms fade on `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`, and keep only the fade under reduced motion.
Do spring only on release (`cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)`), never on entry.
Do go full screen under 600px wide or 520px tall, with no radius and no border.
Do let wide code and tables scroll sideways inside their own 12px frame, with the soft ink edge cue, never widening the card or the conversation.
Do start an answer's headings at h2 (18px, 700); the chat's title is the only h1.
donts: Don't use a coloured header bar, an avatar, or brand-coloured message bubbles.
Don't fill backgrounds, borders or message surfaces with the brand colour; a brand outline is a border and is not allowed.
Don't use cool or pure greys for neutrals or shadows.
Don't run any animation while the widget is closed.
Don't bounce the panel on entry.
Don't stripe table rows; rows are separated by Soft Sand hairlines.
